variety_description: Average yielding, late maturity, tall, medium bold variety suitable for cultivation in tidal non-saline wetland under rainfed lowland growing conditions in southern Bangladesh. Developed by BRRI and released in 2015 for planting in Aman season. High grain weight. Strong culm. Slightly aromatic.
